You're absolutely right, and I apologize for the confusion. 

You can override `CMD` at runtime by simply passing a command to `docker run`:

```
docker run <image> sh
```

This will override the `CMD ["node", "server.js"]` and start a shell instead.

`ENTRYPOINT` is indeed the one that requires `--entrypoint` to override.

So to answer your original question: **No, you don't need a new image.** Just use `docker run <image> sh` to get a shell in the container.
